title: fix(auth): resolve /api/v1/auth/config 404 on Vercel deployment
body:
The `/api/v1/auth/config` endpoint returned 404 on Vercel while working locally. Root cause: route ordering conflict between Hono adapter's catch-all `/auth/*` route and AuthPlugin's specific `/auth/config` registration.

## Changes

**Hono Adapter** (`packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts`)
- Intercept `/auth/config` requests before forwarding to better-auth
- Call `authService.getPublicConfig()` directly for this endpoint

**AuthPlugin** (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`)
- Remove duplicate `/auth/config` route registration from `registerAuthRoutes()`
- Add comment explaining the endpoint is now handled in the adapter

**Tests** (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.test.ts`)
- Update expectations to include `type: 'social'` field in provider responses

## Technical Detail

Hono uses first-match-wins routing. The adapter creates its Hono app with a catch-all `/api/v1/auth/*` route before AuthPlugin can register specific routes in the `kernel:ready` hook. Since `better-auth` doesn't handle `/config` (it's an ObjectStack-specific endpoint), requests were falling through to the dispatcher's mock fallback which doesn't implement this endpoint.

```typescript
// Now handled in adapter before better-auth forwarding
if (path === 'config' && method === 'GET' && authService) {
  const config = authService.getPublicConfig();
  return c.json({ success: true, data: config });
}
```
